types.doc: What `WindowAction::ActivateWindow` answers once the window was asked to come forward.
types.name: ActivationRequested

verbs.description: Bring this app's window to the front. Answers `ActivationRequested` once the window was asked to come forward. An agent brings the window forward; a person looking for it in the window's own palette already has it.
verbs.label: Show this window

schema.description: What `WindowAction::ActivateWindow` answers once the window was asked to come forward.

verbs.description: Open the app at one item: the anchor of a search hit.
verbs.label: Open

verbs.description: Show what a link names, in the app that claims its scheme.
verbs.label: Open link

verbs.description: Read what the app's window shows as lines: every label, value and control in reading order, and the action each control runs, which is called by the address the line names. With `picture`, also the view as a picture; with an `anchor`, shows that item first.
verbs.label: Read the view
